name: field-twin-teal
features: Map loads with the color key, show all, and tap the map to place an entry.
Miles, log and receipt buttons create entries, and new receipt captures a photo stored on the device.
Search, history, spend and mileage views look things up across entries.
Traffic cameras load from a chosen camera source, with a service check.
Export and import back up data, and email link sign in syncs entries to the cloud with sync now and sign out.
